title: Baba na aayenge
body:
Haaye, Zindaaa'n mein jab sakina ki jaa'n lab pe aagayi
boli wo roke kehde pidar se zara koi
hasrat thi nikli aapki godi dum mera
seene pe sar rakhu to mujhe chayn aaega
choome qadam sakina ke jhukkar jo maut ne
boli wo maa se amma karo qibla roo mujhe
<<MINI>>
baba na aayenge, na mujhe neend aayegi..(2)
amma ye raat jaan meri leke jayegi
baba na aayenge, na mujhe neend aayegi..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Ruk ruk ke saans aati hai kholo rasan zara
amma nikalne wala hai seene se dumm mera
kya is andhere ghar mein mujhe maut aayegi
<<MINI>>
amma ye raat jaan meri leke jayegi
baba na aayenge, na mujhe neend aayegi..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Lele ke god mein mujhe roti hai kyu phuphi
kisse chhupa rahi yaha to koi nahi
taqdeer jaane ab kya sitam mujhpe dhaayegi
<<MINI>>
amma ye raat jaan meri leke jayegi
baba na aayenge, na mujhe neend aayegi..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Phir rote rote aankh sakina ki jab lagi
dekha padar ko khwaab mein bachhi tadap uthi
boli sakina baba ke humraah jaayegi
<<MINI>>
amma ye raat jaan meri leke jayegi
baba na aayenge, na mujhe neend aayegi..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Aaye the lene baba abhi to mujhe yaha
aye bibiyo batao pidar hai mere kaha
kehte the ab sakina mere saath jayegi
<<MINI>>
amma ye raat jaan meri leke jayegi
baba na aayenge, na mujhe neend aayegi..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Ye sunke shor e girya utha yu ke al amaa'n
bheja yazeed ne sare shabbir nagahaa'n
qismat pidar se haaye ye kaise milayegi
<<MINI>>
amma ye raat jaan meri leke jayegi
baba na aayenge, na mujhe neend aayegi..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Haye haye rage guloo se tapakta hai khoo'n abhi
baba pe mere kisne jafa is tarah se ki
sadma sakina ab ye utha bhi na payegi
<<MINI>>
amma ye raat jaan meri leke jayegi
baba na aayenge, na mujhe neend aayegi..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Rehan jab sakina ne thama sare hussain
khamosh hogai wo raza karte karte bayn
bano ko muddato ye sada ab rulayegi
<<MINI>>
amma ye raat jaan meri leke jayegi
baba na aayenge, na mujhe neend aayegi..(2)
